  • Medical Doctor with clinical experience

  • Multiple years of experience in pharmacovigilance / medical safety

  • Strong knowledge of global PV regulations (EU GVP, FDA requirements)

  • Experience with global development programs and regulatory submissions

  • Solid understanding of benefit-risk evaluation and safety science

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured working style

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in international teams

Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a Growth-focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Coworking Budget – $200/month to rent a coworking space.

  • Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.

jobs.description:

In this fixed-term role (12-18 months), you will bridge marketing performance with user experience, driving measurable improvements through rigorous experimentation and data-driven optimization.

As Product Manager for SEM Landing Pages, you will lead a cross-functional team including Engineering, Design, SEO, and Performance Marketing to develop, test, and iterate on landing page experiences that convert. You will own the hypothesis-to-insight pipeline: identifying opportunities, designing A/B tests, analyzing results, and translating findings into actionable product improvements. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, as you'll need to balance long-term vision with the discipline of rapid testing and learning.

This position requires you to commute to our Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the SEM landing page product roadmap, prioritizing features and experiments based on conversion impact, user experience, and alignment with marketing objectives

  • Design and execute a continuous testing program, developing hypotheses, running A/B and multivariate tests, and driving statistically rigorous analysis to inform product decisions

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering (who build the pages), SEO (for organic/paid alignment), Design (for user experience), and Performance Marketing (for campaign strategy and goals)

  • Manage the full product lifecycle for landing page features, from initial concept and user research through technical requirements, sprint planning, launch, and post-launch measurement

  • Analyze performance data using SQL, analytics tools, and testing platforms to identify friction points, growth opportunities, and winning variations

  • Champion the user perspective while balancing business goals, ensuring landing pages deliver value to travelers while meeting marketing efficiency targets

  • Communicate insights and progress to product leadership and marketing stakeholders, translating test results into strategic recommendations

  • Drive continuous improvement through iterative testing, performance monitoring, and a relentless focus on conversion rate optimization

Please apply if you have:

  • Have 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in product management, preferably in a B2C tech, e-commerce, or travel company.

  • Possess a proven ability to independently manage and ship product features in an agile environment.

  • Have demonstrated experience owning product features from concept to launch, including managing a backlog and working with engineering squads.

  • Maintain strong analytical skills, with experience in A/B testing and data analysis to drive strategic decisions.

  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build consensus across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Bring a strong sense of user empathy and a passion for building products that solve real-world traveler problems.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or have equivalent hands-on professional experience.

  • Thrive in a high-ownership environment where you can take initiative and move projects forward with minimal supervision.

Benefits and Perks

  • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Product Manager: Alternative Payment Processing

Checkout.com is seeking a Product Manager and leader to join our team of product managers working to add and improve our Alternative Payment Method (APM) portfolio, with a focus on bank-based payment rails. This role will help drive our company OKR of expanding and enhancing the payment methods we offer merchants around the world, helping these businesses grow their global footprint. The successful candidate will provide cross-functional leadership across product, engineering, and business teams, to ensure our APM portfolio is embedded throughout Checkout.com’s ecosystem, enabling a seamless experience for our merchants. They will work across the business and engage with merchants to align on the selection of APMs, drive the recommended approach to offer or improve them, design the API experience and collaborate with more than twenty stakeholder teams to deliver APMs end-to-end. Daily tasks include understanding stakeholders’ pain points, driving prioritization for product development, and developing new capabilities for our customers.

About you:

  • 3-5 years of product management experience.

  • Experience working in payment methods, especially direct debit and account-to-account payment methods

  • Data-driven: Skilled at leveraging data and business insights to determine strategic priorities and drive the product roadmap and execution.

  • Customer-first: Think from the customer's perspective and can balance future opportunities with immediate needs.

  • End-to-end mindset: Think in a structured and diligent manner, understanding all key components necessary to drive the ongoing success of a product.

  • Leadership: Excellent at collaborating with stakeholders in product, engineering, commercial, and business teams proactively, demonstrating high EQ and influencing skills.

  • Effective communicator: Able to inspire others with a shared vision and simplify complex concepts for a wide range of audiences.

Key responsibilities:

  • Set the strategy for your portfolio of APMs, including understanding the target market, customers and aims for each APM, to determine the best approach for delivering the APMs, and how to balance adding new APMs vs working on enhancements for the existing portfolio, using qualitative and quantitative research and data to make decisions.

  • Become an expert in your payment methods, working closely with the payment partners to understand trends and drivers for success, which you will leverage to support our commercial team and drive value for our merchants.

  • Work with engineering and product counterparts to design the API and integration for each APM, to deliver an optimal developer experience which balances a consistent API experience across Checkout.com’s products with the nuances of each different APM.

  • Build strong partnerships with business, product, and technology stakeholders and work with them for their buy-in and collaboration to generate momentum for your products

  • Work with other product and engineering leaders to ensure alignment with their roadmaps and delivery

  • Gain a deep understanding of Checkout.com ’s customers and business.

  • Foster a team culture that upholds Checkout.com’s operating principles.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

About the Role

As the Head of Program Management, you will own the execution of our project portfolio from first concept to series production across Automotive, Commercial Vehicle, and Industrial BESS. That means leading teams of Project Leads, Product Owners, and Field Application Engineers, and reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer. You are an entrepreneurial leader who thrives on turning complex development roadmaps into tangible, high-quality products while balancing the unique demands of both vehicle-level and grid-scale energy storage safety and performance.

Your Future Tasks at a glance

  • Operational Excellence: Oversee the end-to-end execution of all projects, ensuring they meet milestones, budget constraints, and resource allocations. Identify cross-project synergies and manage dependencies to mitigate systemic risks.

  • Team Mentorship: Lead Team Leads and senior contributors to foster professional and technical growth.

  • Strategic Staffing: Optimize organizational structure and resource allocation across programs to balance capacity, driving throughput and profitability.

  • Department Alignment: Act as the primary interface for C-level management, aligning departmental goals with the overall company strategy and reporting on KPIs.

  • Governance & Process Design: Define and continuously optimize department processes and interfaces to other departments (Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Quality).

  • Conflict & Escalation Management: Serve as the ultimate internal escalation point for critical project roadblocks, and make the call.

  • Commercial & Technical Stewardship: Ensure that both commercial governance (contracts, deliveries) and technical maturity (e.g. V-cycle, ASPICE) stay on track across all programs.

Who you are and what you have

  • Experience: 8+ years of leadership in Program or Project Management, specifically in automotive, battery, or power electronics. You have successfully led a "team of teams."

  • Education: A university degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field that combines technical understanding with commercial acumen.

  • The "Advocacy" Trait: You are comfortable pushing back. When cross-functional goals conflict, you can mediate and make firm decisions, acting as a buffer for your team rather than just escalating or deferring.

  • Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams (interacting with HW, SW, Systems, Operations) and manage leaders (Team Leads).

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust with international Tier-1 or OEM customers and navigate C-level stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Impact: A key leadership role (~30 direct or indirect reports) with the autonomy to shape the future of our program management organization.

  • Culture: A flat hierarchy that values direct, honest communication and fast decision-making over process for process’s sake.

  • Growth: Be at the forefront of the green energy transition, in a high-tech, international, fast-growing company.

  • Flexibility: Modern working conditions with a focus on results.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

  • Participate in an on-call rotation and 3rd level escalation support to ensure the system is meeting its objectives

  • Experience independently shipping complex products in a software environment, not just executing scoped tasks

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment, including helping others break down and sequence their work

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

Must Haves:

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to run AI-assisted workflows for complex features, diagnosing why AI output is weak and fixing the setup, not only the result

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly across a full feature or surface area, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations, catching pattern-level UX problems before they reach users

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to turn vague direction into a clear product approach, define success criteria, cut scope intelligently, and know when evidence is strong enough to proceed

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture: reviews implementation quality beyond “does it work”, evaluates maintainability, test coverage, and architectural fit, and contributes beyond a pure frontend scope over time

jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is looking for a Senior Information Security Manager to strengthen our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function. You'll own the day-to-day operation of our information security and compliance program, with a strong focus on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and a bonus if you bring HIPAA or BSI C5 experience to the table.

This isn't a "gatekeeper" role. We're a SaaS scale-up, and our product teams move fast. We need someone who understands risk well enough to take calculated ones, someone who can say "yes, and here's how we do it safely" instead of defaulting to "no." You'll be the person who keeps compliance moving at the speed of the business, not the person who slows it down.

You'll be part of our Information Security team, sitting within the broader Security track alongside the IT Security team, both under our Head of Security. You'll work closely with your teammates in Information Security and IT Security to make sure security and compliance work hand in hand rather than in separate lanes.

Your responsibilities

Program ownership

  • Own and continuously improve our Information Security Management System (ISMS), keeping it aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and, where relevant, HIPAA and BSI C5

  • Maintain and mature our risk register, policy library, vendor/third-party risk assessments, and control monitoring

Audits & evidence

  • Act as a hands-on participant in audits, working directly with auditors, control owners, and leadership to prepare, execute, and close out certification and attestation cycles efficiently rather than through brute force

  • Build and refine evidence collection processes using automation and GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or similar), reducing manual overhead and audit fatigue across the company

  • Design and roll out a model where product and engineering teams own their evidence throughout the control lifecycle, rather than compliance chasing people down before every audit

Risk & business partnership

  • Assess risk pragmatically: identify real security and compliance exposure, size it accurately, and make calculated calls that unblock product and engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering, product, IT, People, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into existing workflows rather than bolting them on afterward

  • Track regulatory and customer-driven compliance requirements — new customer security questionnaires, evolving frameworks — and translate them into practical, actionable controls

Reporting

  • Report on the state of the security and compliance program to stakeholders and leadership, including audit readiness, open risks, and remediation progress

Qualities we look for

  • 3-5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance roles, ideally at a SaaS company, and ideally at scaleup pace and scale

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs and audits, from control design through evidence collection to certification

  • Experience with HIPAA and/or BSI C5 is a strong plus

  • Practical experience with GRC/evidence automation tooling such as Vanta (or equivalent), including building smooth, low-friction processes around it

  • A track record of building processes that shift evidence ownership to the teams generating the evidence, rather than centralizing it all in compliance

  • Sound risk judgment: comfortable making calculated, defensible risk decisions to keep product teams unblocked, rather than reflexively blocking

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; able to work credibly with engineers, product managers, and leadership without becoming an obstacle

  • Fluent English and German language skills at C1 level (or close by) are required

  • Clear, structured communicator who can translate compliance requirements into language engineering and product teams actually act on

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Engineering Manager, K4B
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK for Business, we're building the future of corporate travel technology — and the engineering teams behind it are at the heart of that mission. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead one or more agile engineering teams delivering software that helps companies and their travelers move smarter and with less friction, while playing a key role in shaping our growing engineering hub.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office at least 3 days per week.

In this role you will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery for one or more agile engineering teams, ensuring the team consistently ships high-quality software aligned with product and business objectives, measured against clear KPIs.

  • Define and drive the technical roadmap for your team's domain — collaborating with product managers and peer engineering leaders to translate business goals into a prioritized, executable plan.

  • Design and enforce engineering best practices across the team's codebase, including coding standards, testing strategies, observability, and clear Definition of Done criteria, raising the overall quality bar.

  • Lead hiring and performance management for a team of software engineers, owning the full employee lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding through career development, performance reviews, and promotions.

  • Coach and develop engineers at all levels — including senior engineers and emerging technical leads — through regular 1:1s, structured feedback, and deliberate career conversations that build the next generation of leaders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and peer engineering managers to plan and deliver complex, multi-team initiatives, ensuring clear alignment on scope, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Identify and remove delivery risks proactively — whether organizational, technical, or process-related — and drive improvements without waiting to be directed, keeping the team operating at high velocity.

  • Champion a culture of quality and continuous improvement, embedding practices such as blameless post-mortems, structured incident response, and iterative process refinement into the team's day-to-day rhythm.

  • Influence technical architecture across the team's domain by preparing and participating in design reviews, guiding architectural decisions, and ensuring systems are built for scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Help build and shape the engineering presence, contributing to local talent acquisition, onboarding, and team culture as part of the organization's strategic expansion of its engineering hub.

Please apply if you have:

  • 1+ years of experience leading engineering teams within the travel industry focused on supplier integrations (such as flights, hotels, or trains using Direct APIs, GDS, NDC, NDC[X]) or managing teams executing large-scale third-party content integrations.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role directly managing software engineers, and a proven track record of leading productive teams and shipping high-quality software in a fast-paced environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills considered.

  • A proven track record of ownership and innovation within a data-driven, results-oriented environment, along with the ability to rapidly learn and master new business domains.

  • A track record of steering organizational transformation, maximizing gains from agile methodologies, and fostering process optimization and innovation

  • Strong technical fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, and backend service architecture, with the ability to credibly guide architectural decisions and participate meaningfully in design reviews.

  • Demonstrated experience owning the full people management lifecycle — hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and promotions — with a genuine commitment to developing engineering talent.

  • Experience coaching and developing engineers at multiple levels, including senior engineers and emerging technical leads, through structured feedback, regular 1:1s, and deliberate career conversations.

  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies and the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices; comfortable driving process improvements within a sprint-based team.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision to both technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively across product, design, and engineering functions.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Hands-on experience with modern software development tooling — including version control systems (e.g., GitHub), issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and logging or observability platforms — and a demonstrated openness to adopting AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity.

  • Comfort working in a distributed, multilingual engineering organization with teams across multiple time zones and office locations.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; no specific certification is required.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

jobs.title: Videograf & Bewegtbild Producer
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Mittelständische Beratungsunternehmen sehen im Bewegtbild fast überall gleich aus — Stock-Aufnahmen, eine Logo-Animation, alle drei Jahre ein Imagefilm von einer Agentur. Video ist in der Branche selten eine eigene Sprache. Genau dort liegt der Hebel: Wer Beratung in Deutschland neu denkt, muss auch neu aussehen und sich neu anfühlen — im Recruiting, gegenüber Mandanten, in jeder Geschichte, die wir erzählen.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Design und Content sind bei uns kein Anhängsel einer Fachabteilung, sondern im Herzen des Unternehmens verankert — und wir bauen gerade die gesamte Bewegtbild-Infrastruktur dafür auf. Diese Rolle existiert, weil wir Video nicht einkaufen, sondern selbst produzieren wollen: in eigener Handschrift, in einer Frequenz, die eine Agentur nie tragen könnte, und auf einem visuellen Niveau, das man von den besten Modehäusern und Technologiemarken kennt — und in unserer Branche niemand erwartet. Genau das ist der Reiz: der Beweis, dass hier jemand versteht, was gutes Bild und gutes Design ausmacht.

Du bist Bildgestalter mit technischem Fundament — jemand, der Kameraführung, Licht und Ton beherrscht und für schöne Bilder lebt. Du hast drei bis fünf Jahre Bewegtbild von der Kamera bis zur Postproduktion verantwortet — in einem Produktionshaus, einem In-house-Content-Team einer Marke mit hohem visuellen Anspruch, einer Kreativ-Agentur oder selbstständig mit eigenen Arbeiten. Du wechselst aus der Auftrags- und Projektlogik, in der du fremde Vorgaben umsetzt und nach dem letzten Cut zum nächsten Kunden weiterziehst — und willst jetzt eine eigene Video-Pipeline von Grund auf bauen, mit einer Bildsprache, die deine Handschrift trägt, und Formaten, die bleiben. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen — etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis — und eine Content-Kultur im Aufbau, die du von Anfang an mitgestaltest.

Du arbeitest in München als Teil des Brand, Content & Demand Teams und berichtest an den Brand, Content & Demand Lead. Dein Team kommt aus der Design-, Marketing- und Agenturwelt — Menschen, die wissen, was guter Content und gutes Design sind, und die dich in deiner Arbeit fordern, statt dich zu verwalten. Du verantwortest alle Bewegtbildformate von Vogel — von der Idee bis zur Postproduktion — vom wöchentlichen Social-Clip über Recruiting- und Mandanten-Formate bis zum Dokumentarfilm. Gemeinsam mit dem Team und Moritz Vogel prägst du den visuellen Stil der Marke mit: Wie übersetzt sich die Vogel-Markenstrategie in Bewegtbild? Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in eine Senior-Rolle wie Lead Video mit eigenem kleinen Team.

Deine Verantwortung

Formate von der Idee bis zur Postproduktion

  • Verantworte den kompletten Produktionsweg in einer Hand — Konzept und Storyboard, Kameraführung und Licht am Set, Schnitt, Color Grading und Sounddesign in der Post. Vom Bild im Kopf bis zum fertigen Export.

  • Steuere bei größeren Drehs bei Bedarf eine Dreh-Assistenz oder ein kleines Team, das dir zuarbeitet.

  • Trage die laufende Cadence — wöchentliche Social-Media-Clips und vier bis acht Drehs pro Monat, mindestens sechs Mandanten-Dokumentationen im Jahr. Formate, die wiederkehren und trotzdem nie beliebig aussehen.

  • Drehe die großen Stücke: Recruiting- und Mandanten-Formate, Talk-Formate für YouTube und die Aufbereitung als Podcast sowie Dokumentarfilme, die zeigen, wer hinter den Unternehmen steht, die wir beraten. Anspruch statt Imagefilm von der Stange.

Die Video-Pipeline und der visuelle Stil der Marke

  • Bau die Video-Content-Pipeline von Grund auf — Produktions-Workflow, wiederverwendbare Format-Templates, Asset- und Rohmaterial-Management, Export-Standards. Die volle Produktion läuft ab den ersten Wochen; was über die Zeit reift, sind Workflow, Tempo und Wiederholbarkeit, nicht die Menge.

  • Präge den visuellen Stil der Vogel-Bewegtbildsprache aktiv mit — Bildlook, Schnittrhythmus, Farbwelt, Ton. Du übersetzt die Vogel-Markenstrategie in Bewegtbild und machst daraus eine unverwechselbare Handschrift auf einem Niveau, das in der Beratungsbranche niemand erwartet.

  • Verantworte das professionelle Equipment, das dir gestellt wird — Kamera-, Licht- und Ton-Stack. Du entscheidest, was du brauchst, und holst das Maximum aus dem Setup.

Event-Verwertung und Zusammenarbeit im Content-Team

  • Übertrage Live-Formate in digitalen Content — dokumentiere unsere Anlässe (Webinare, Town Halls, Mitarbeiterevents, ab 2027 die Aalen-Mittelstandskonferenz) und mach aus jedem Event wiederverwertbare Formate.

  • Arbeite eng mit dem Editorial & Community Associate und dem Junior Content Creator zusammen — Bewegtbild ist Teil einer größeren Content-Maschine, kein Solo-Silo.

  • Stimm den visuellen Stil regelmäßig mit dem Brand, Content & Demand Lead und Moritz Vogel ab — schnelle Iteration, gestalterischer Freiraum, gemeinsame Format-Roadmap.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Die volle Produktions-Cadence läuft — wöchentliche Social-Clips, vier bis acht Drehs pro Monat, die ersten Mandanten-Dokumentationen abgedreht und geschnitten. Das läuft ab den ersten Wochen, nicht erst nach einer langen Anlaufphase.

  • Du hast mehrere fertige Formate abgeliefert, die sichtbar auf Niveau sind — Employer-Brand, Mandanten-Portrait, Event-Verwertung — und die erste Version deines Produktions-Workflows steht.

  • Dein Kamera-, Licht- und Ton-Stack ist aufgebaut, und du hast die ersten Talk-Formate produziert und für YouTube sowie als Podcast aufbereitet.

Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Die Video-Pipeline steht robust — die wöchentliche Cadence und vier bis acht Drehs pro Monat laufen verlässlich, mindestens sechs Mandanten-Dokumentationen im Jahr sind produziert, die Event-Verwertung ist eingespielt.

  • Deine visuelle Handschrift ist in der Vogel-Bewegtbildsprache klar erkennbar — auf einem Niveau, das man einer Beratung nicht zutraut, abgestimmt mit Team und Moritz Vogel.

  • Du hast die Aalen-Mittelstandskonferenz 2027 bewegtbild-seitig konzipiert — von der Dreh-Planung bis zur Übertragung der Live-Formate in digitalen Content.

Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Vogel-Bewegtbild hat eine sichtbare, unverwechselbare Bildsprache mit Reputation in der Kreativ- und Video-Szene — ein Name, den Filmschaffende kennen. Videos, die man teilt, weil sie gut sind, nicht weil sie von uns kommen.

  • Die Dokumentarfilm- und Talk-Formate über Mandanten laufen als wiederkehrende Reihen.

  • Du bist Kandidat für die nächste Stufe — eine Lead-Rolle mit eigener Bewegtbild-Architektur.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Der nächste Schritt ist eine Senior-Rolle wie Lead Video (IC-Karriere) — das setzt eine eigenständig aufgebaute Pipeline und eine sichtbare Vogel-Bildsprache voraus, nicht zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Über weitere Verantwortung öffnet sich der Pfad entlang unseres Karriere-Frameworks, perspektivisch mit einem eigenen kleinen Produktionsteam oder einem Netzwerk externer Gewerke unter deiner kreativen Führung.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du hast drei bis fünf Jahre Bewegtbild end-to-end verantwortet — in einem Produktionshaus, einem In-house-Content-Team einer Marke mit hohem visuellen Anspruch, einer Kreativ- oder Filmagentur oder selbstständig.

  • Du beherrschst Kameraführung, Licht und Ton am Set genauso wie die Postproduktion — Schnitt, Color Grading, Sounddesign. Beides in einer Person, nicht arbeitsteilig delegiert.

  • Du zeigst uns ein paar starke visuelle Arbeitsproben — egal welcher Inhalt: Musikvideo, Dokumentation, Social Clips, Podcast, Eventfilm. Kein aufpoliertes Showreel nötig, aber das Visuelle muss stimmen. Daran werden wir gemessen, und daran messen wir dich.

  • Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber echtes bildgestalterisches Können und Postproduktions-Tiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Die ausgeschriebene Range kalibriert auf das Primärprofil. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast Bildgeschmack — du erkennst intuitiv, wann eine Einstellung, ein Schnitt oder ein Grade trägt und wann er kippt, ohne dass dir jemand die Regel nennt.

  • Du beherrschst deinen Postproduktions-Stack sicher — Premiere oder DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Grundlagen im Sounddesign — und arbeitest sauber und organisiert im Rohmaterial.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug — für Recherche und Moodboards, Skript- und Storyboard-Drafts, Transkription und Untertitel, Rough-Cuts und Asset-Organisation. Repetitive Aufgaben sind dir ein Reiz zur Automatisierung, kein Schicksal.

  • Du iterierst eigenständig und schnell — du bringst eine Bildidee in den ersten Termin mit, statt auf ein Briefing zu warten, und drehst schlank statt mit großem Apparat.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

  • Du hast Stil und Geschmack — nicht nur im Bild, sondern in allem, was du machst. Du erkennst, was Klasse hat und was nur teuer aussieht.

  • Du misst dich an den Besten — an Marken und Studios, die visuell Maßstäbe setzen, nicht an dem, was in der Beratungsbranche üblich ist.

  • Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Die Steuerberaterin und der Unternehmer vor deiner Kamera wissen Dinge über ihre Welt, die in keinem Storyboard stehen — die besten Bilder entstehen, wenn du zuhörst.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Kein Auftraggeber-Modus, in dem du Agenturen briefst und Ergebnisse abnimmst. Wir produzieren selbst — Kamera, Schnitt, Color und Ton in deiner Hand. Du bist Bildgestalter, kein Account-Manager.

  • Kein Hochglanz-Agentur-Workflow mit großem Crew-Apparat und monatelangem Vorlauf. Wir iterieren in kurzen Zyklen und drehen schlank — bei größeren Produktionen mit Assistenz, aber immer mit dem Anspruch, am Detail selbst zu schrauben.

  • Kein reiner Schnittplatz ohne Kamera — und keine reine Kamera ohne Post. Du verantwortest den ganzen Weg. Wer nur eine Hälfte des Handwerks will, sitzt hier am falschen Schreibtisch.

  • Kein Corporate-Video nach Freigabe-Matrix. Du bekommst gestalterischen Freiraum und Raum für visuelle Experimente — und trägst dafür die Verantwortung, dass jedes Format wirkt. Wer nur abgezeichnete Briefings abarbeiten will, ist hier nicht richtig.

  • Kein Karriere-Aufstieg durch Personalspanne. Du wächst durch die Tiefe deines Handwerks und die Sichtbarkeit deiner Bildsprache, nicht durch immer mehr Direct Reports.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen.

3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus?

Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.

Benefits

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

jobs.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir bauen die technologische Infrastruktur für CO₂-Prämien in der Elektromobilität: regulatorische Prozesse und Finanzflüsse für B2C- und B2B-Kunden, digital abgewickelt.

Das heißt konkret: Statusmodelle mit rechtlicher Konsequenz, Auszahlungslogik, Nachweisketten, Schnittstellen zu Behörden und Partnern. Die Domäne ist der schwierige Teil, nicht das Framework.

Die spannende Aufgabe der nächsten Monate: Unsere Hauptanwendung läuft auf Rails 8. Zwei weitere Anwendungen sollen in diese Codebasis aufgenommen werden. Das ist keine Portierungsarbeit, sondern eine Modellierungsfrage — drei gewachsene Domänen mit überlappenden Begriffen zu einem konsistenten System zusammenführen, ohne dass am Ende alles mit allem zusammenhängt. Wer gern über Bounded Contexts und die richtigen Schnitte nachdenkt, findet hier reichlich Substanz.

Wir betreiben auf Linode und Bare Metal mit PostgreSQL, Redis und Sidekiq. CI/CD läuft über GitHub Actions, Monitoring und Observability über AppSignal.

Das Team besteht aus vier Entwicklern und einem Product Owner, davon zwei Rails-Seniors. Wir haben eine gemeinsame Vorstellung davon, wo die Systemarchitektur hin soll, und beraten uns gegenseitig zu unseren Lösungen. Entscheidungen fallen im Team, nicht auf einer Ebene darüber.

Aufgaben

  • Konsolidierung - Du führst zwei bestehende Anwendungen in die Rails-8-Codebasis über und triffst dabei die Schnitte, die das System danach tragen.

  • Domänenmodell schärfen - Du überführst gewachsene Geschäftslogik in tragfähige Abstraktionen und benennst Prozesse so, wie das Business sie tatsächlich denkt — nicht so, wie die Tabelle gerade heißt.

  • Features end-to-end - Vom Spec-Gespräch mit dem Product Owner bis zum Deployment auf Production.

  • Architektur mitgestalten - Du bringst deine Sicht in die Architekturdiskussion ein, lässt dich von der Sicht der anderen überzeugen und hältst gemeinsam Getroffenes durch.

  • Wissen weitergeben - Pull Requests sind bei uns der Ort, an dem Rails-Wissen wandert in beide Richtungen. Du schreibst Reviews, aus denen jemand etwas lernt, und ziehst weniger erfahrene Entwickler aktiv hoch.

  • Deployment und Betrieb - Du machst den Deploy-Prozess schneller und verlässlicher.

  • Standards - Style Guides und Konventionen tragen und weiterentwickeln, damit der Code bei vier Entwicklern wie von einer Hand aussieht.

Qualifikation

Must have

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre produktive Rails-Erfahrung an einer Anwendung, die du über längere Zeit betreut hast — nicht nur aufgesetzt.
  • Affinität zu Domain Driven Design. Du erkennst, wann ein Modell zu viel weiß, wann eine Abstraktion fehlt und wann ein Begriff im Code nicht dem im Fachgespräch entspricht.
  • Mentoring-Mindset. Du erklärst gern, warum etwas so gelöst ist, und siehst Reviews nicht als Qualitätskontrolle, sondern als Wissenstransfer.
  • Keine Scheu vor einem puren Ubuntu-Server. SSH, systemd, Logs, Deployment-Scripte — du arbeitest direkt auf der Maschine, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Bereitschaft, dich an bestehende Style Guides zu halten und sie zu verbessern, statt sie zu umgehen.
  • Du bringst Leistung in einer locker geführten Runde. Wir arbeiten mit wenig Prozess und flacher Hierarchie. Das funktioniert nur mit Leuten, die sich selbst strukturieren und Verantwortung nicht abgeben.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung damit, mehrere Anwendungen oder Services zu einer Codebasis zusammenzuführen.
    PostgreSQL über Grundlagen hinaus: Query-Analyse, Indizierung, Migrationen auf großen Tabellen ohne Downtime
  • Erfahrung mit regulierten Domänen — Energie, Finanzen, Mobilität.
  • Sidekiq unter Last, idempotente Jobs, Retry-Strategien.
  • Frontend-Grundverständnis für die Zusammenarbeit an den Schnittstellen (Hotwire/Turbo, React oder Vue) — wir suchen hier aber ausdrücklich keine Frontend-Person.

Benefits

  • Echte Architekturarbeit an einem System, das gerade zusammenwächst — und ein Team, mit dem man darüber diskutieren kann
  • Direkter Impact: Was du baust, geht in Produktion, oft am selben Tag
  • Ein Produkt, das messbar zur Verkehrswende beiträgt
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 100 % mobiles Arbeiten
  • Attraktives Gehalt und Bonusmodelle
  • Fortbildungen und Karriereentwicklung
  • Regelmäßige Workations, um das Team live zu treffen

We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for n8n’s commercial engine and help Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships make sharper, data-driven investment decisions.

To make that happen, you’ll co-own the GTM plan, turn commercial strategy into actionable financial insight, and build the models and operating rhythms that support n8n’s next stage of growth:

DRIVE GTM PLANNING AND FORECASTING

  • Lead n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for GTM, from top-down target setting and cross-functional alignment through to consolidation into the company plan.

MODEL COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain reliable as assumptions and business conditions change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You turn complex financial analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to GTM leaders, executives, and board audiences.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You actively use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your work.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

The Transaction Monitoring (TM) Compliance Manager is a specialized financial crime risk and regulatory oversight role within the Second Line of Defence (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance department. The successful candidate is responsible for providing independent oversight, objective evaluation, and compliance challenges regarding the efficacy of the firm's Transaction Monitoring framework.

Acting as a Second Line Subject Matter Expert (SME), the individual defines the regulatory envelope, assesses TM risk coverage, and reviews the governance, methodologies, and documentation underpinning detection mechanisms. This role does not own control execution or technical solution design; instead, it provides independent assurance to ensure that the firm’s monitoring practices remain aligned with defined risk appetite, internal policies, and global regulatory expectations (AML/CTF/CPF).


Key Responsibilities:


1. Compliance Oversight in Risk Assessment & Horizon Scanning

  • Independent Review: Lead the ongoing 2LoD evaluation and challenge of the Compliance Risk Assessments (including EWRA and Product Risk Assessments) to ensure they accurately reflect current transaction data, typologies, and product utilization trends.

  • Regulatory Surveying & Horizon Scanning: Proactively monitor, survey, and analyze shifts in the global regulatory landscape, financial crime trends, and regulatory enforcement actions to ensure the firm's TM Compliance risk assessment framework remains comprehensive and defensible.

  • Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management.

2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework

  • Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles.

  • Compliance Oversight in Tuning & Optimization: Review and evaluate the methodologies, statistical testing parameters, and documentation for periodic "Below-the-Line" (BTL) and "Above-the-Line" (ATL) testing performed by the First Line to ensure robust governance.

  • Residual Risk Opining: Formulate independent compliance opinions regarding residual risk acceptance, providing formal advisory input to governance forums and the Global MLROs.

3. Governance, Risk, & Reporting

  • Model Risk Governance: Participate in the compliance review of TM systems and model validation exercises, independently assessing the transparency, logic, and regulatory defensibility of detection models against applicable guidance (e.g., FCA guidance on model risk management).

  • Strategic Alignment: Provide regulatory compliance support to the Head of TM to assist in aligning roadmap initiatives with the compliance maturity framework.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Engage with cross-functional stakeholders across lines of defense to communicate compliance requirements and support the adherence to established TM standards.

  • Governance & Escalation Paths: Support the enhancement of the TM compliance governance framework to facilitate the structured, independent escalation of risk metrics to senior management.

  • Metrics & KRI Oversight: Assist in the production of 2LoD Management Information (MI) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to track the effectiveness of the compliance oversight posture for the Head of TM and Global MLRO.

3. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance

  • Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

  • Lifecycle Evaluation: Evaluate the end-to-end alert workflow governance, risk scoring frameworks, and prioritization mechanics to ensure high-risk alerts adhere to compliant escalation paths.

  • Feedback Loops: Analyze high-level alert outcomes and disposition trends to provide compliance feedback loops to technical teams, supporting iterative improvements in the quality of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Typically 5+ years of experience within Financial Crime Compliance, with a specific focus on the independent oversight, assurance, or evaluation of Transaction Monitoring frameworks within a regulated PSP, FinTech, or financial institution.

  • 2LoD Competency: Proven experience operating within a Second Line of Defence capacity, demonstrating the ability to independently challenge technical teams, data models, and threshold tuning documentation objectively.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the UK Money Laundering Regulations (MLRs), JMLSG Guidance, and international FATF standards.

  • Systems & Data Literacy: Familiarity with data analysis methodologies, data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), or basic query languages (e.g., SQL) sufficient to independently evaluate data testing outputs, methodologies, and audit trails.

  • Education & Professional Certifications: A Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Criminology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional certifications from recognized bodies (e.g., ICA International Diploma in AML, ACAMS) are highly regarded.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

 

What you'll be doing

As our Fincrime Analyst, you’ll be the person who leads the surveillance, identification, and containment of real-time fraudulent and illicit activities across our ecosystem. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • High-Volume Alert Review & Resolution – Managing, analyzing, and resolving transaction monitoring alerts flagged by our systems, ensuring swift and accurate decision-making on complex or ambiguous customer behaviors.

  • Advanced Escalation Handling – Serving as the primary point of contact for complex alerts escalated by other teams, conducting the necessary deep dives to quickly determine if further investigation or filing is required.

  • Detection Logic Feedback Loop – Translating insights gained from your daily alert reviews into actionable feedback for Product and Data teams to help tune, refine, and update our transaction monitoring rules.

  • Process & Workflow Optimization – Identifying bottlenecks in the daily alert handling queue and proposing tactical improvements to streamline workflows, reduce false positives, and increase team efficiency.

  • Mentorship on the Line – Coaching and onboarding junior analysts by sharing best practices on transaction analysis, pattern recognition, and effective case documentation.

  • Compliance & Airtight Documentation – Ensuring every resolved alert is backed by clear, concise, and defensible rationale that strictly adheres to regulatory standards and internal guidelines.

  • Typology Hunting – Owning a strategic monitoring 'Focal Area', actively researching emerging global financial crime trends and swiftly translating them into live, production-ready transaction detection rules.

Who we're looking for

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you?

  • Experience – 3+ years of hands-on experience in transaction monitoring, real-time fraud operations, or KYT surveillance, specifically within hyper-growth Fintechs, fast-paced digital banking networks, or high-volume payment processing environments.

  • Surveillance Mastery – Subject matter expertise in transaction monitoring principles, payment flows, velocity patterns, and regulatory frameworks (FATF, EU Directives, PSD3/SCA). Professional industry certifications (e.g., CAMS, CFE) are highly valued.

  • Advanced Data & Systems Literacy – High proficiency in navigating complex data landscapes using internal data analytics tools (such as Looker, Splunk, HEX, or Redshift) and leveraging basic SQL to query and manipulate large transactional datasets.

  • Rule Engineering Mindset – A strong track record of identifying structural gaps in automated detection models and turning those gaps into concrete, logic-driven monitoring scenarios.

  • Leadership & Coaching Presence – Demonstrated ability to guide peers, design operational training modules, and elevate the monitoring and analytical competencies of a wider operational team.

  • Analytical Communication – Exceptional ability to synthesize complex transaction data and chaotic payment behaviors into structured, clear, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Core Values – Extreme attention to detail, resilience under high transaction-alert volumes, and the unwavering ethical judgment needed to manage sensitive risk incidents.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Senior People Data Analyst, you will play a leading role in the People Analytics team at Checkout.com. Our mission is to enable data-driven people decisions across the organisation — from the executive team to individual managers.

You will combine deep analytics engineering experience with end-to-end product ownership: bringing the technical discipline to raise the quality of our data ecosystem, the stakeholder instincts to deliver products that people actually use, and the curiosity to push the boundary of what People Analytics can do through machine learning and AI.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real scope. You will own a portfolio of stakeholder relationships, co-own the evolution of our data platform, and contribute to one of the most ambitious People Analytics strategies in the business.

Job responsibilities

Data ecosystem quality: Lead the continuous improvement of the People Analytics data ecosystem — including pipeline quality, semantic layer, and the data products we share with other teams. You will bring the rigour of an established data engineering team to our stack, ensuring our data is reliable, well-documented, and ready to power AI-driven products.

End-to-end product development: Own the full product development lifecycle for assigned stakeholder groups — from requirements gathering and design to pipeline development, Looker delivery, and enablement. You will be the primary People Analytics partner for Business Partnering and Finance, responsible for both supporting existing products and delivering new ones.

Machine learning and AI: Design, build, and deploy ML models and AI-powered data products. Working from our People Analytics AI roadmap, you will identify high-value use cases and deliver production-grade solutions — from predictive people models to intelligent data applications — using our cloud-native stack.

Advanced analytics: Conduct analyses that go beyond what happened to explain why and anticipate what comes next. Partner with the People Analytics Manager and senior stakeholders on the most complex and strategically important questions.

Enablement: Drive data fluency across your stakeholder groups through demos, documentation, training, and self-service tooling. Make data accessible, not just available.

Growth opportunities

We want this role to grow. As you establish yourself:

  • Broader product ownership: Expand into additional stakeholder groups and more complex, cross-functional products

  • AI at scale: Build increasingly sophisticated AI products — from predictive models to deployed data applications used across the business

  • Strategic influence: Move further into consultative and diagnostic work, shaping how senior leaders interpret and act on people data

Key requirements

Essential:

  • Significant experience as a data analyst or analytics engineer in a team with established data engineering practices

  • Strong SQL, with hands-on experience in BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse

  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines with dbt or a comparable transformation tool

  • Experience building dashboards and data products end-to-end for business stakeholders, ideally in Looker

  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences

  • Collaborative, enablement-focused mindset: you build for self-service, not dependency

Desirable:

  • Experience with machine learning or statistical modelling in a production context

  • Exposure to AI product development, LLM tooling, or data applications

  • Experience with data quality frameworks, semantic layers, or data observability tooling

  • Prior experience working with HR, people, or workforce data

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Als zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bist du zugleich technischer Sparringspartner unseres Information Security Officers bei der Aufrechterhaltung unserer ISO-27001-Zertifizierung und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren externen IT-Dienstleistern.

Dich erwartet eine solide bestehende IT-Landschaft mit spannenden Weiterentwicklungsprojekten: Dazu gehören der schrittweise Aufbau und die Übernahme von Teilen der Microsoft-365-Administration inhouse, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung laufender Security-Projekte sowie die Modernisierung der IT-Infrastruktur an unserem Berliner Standort.

Aufgaben

Sorge dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden produktiv arbeiten können: Behebe Hard-, Software- und Netzwerkprobleme eigenständig und praxisnah. Dank umfassender Administratorrechte und kurzer Entscheidungswege kannst du schnell und effizient unterstützen.

Verantworte den gesamten Hardware-Lebenszyklus: Von Laptops über Mobilgeräte bis hin zu Firewalls. Dazu gehören Beschaffung, Inventarisierung, Austausch und Entsorgung in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren IT-Partnern.

Administriere unsere Cloud-Systeme: Dazu zählen Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Intune, Atlassian (Jira & Confluence), unser Passwortmanagement-System sowie weitere zentrale IT-Anwendungen.

Arbeite eng mit unserem Information Security Officer zusammen: Unterstütze bei der Umsetzung des Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems (ISMS) sowie von Cyber-Security-Maßnahmen, beispielsweise Access Reviews, Firewall- und VPN-Richtlinien sowie der Absicherung von Endgeräten.

Steuere unsere externen IT-Dienstleister: Übernimm die Koordination von Anfragen, regelmäßigen Abstimmungsterminen, Kostenkontrolle sowie das Management von Verträgen und Serviceleistungen.

Modernisiere die Netzwerkinfrastruktur unseres Berliner Standorts: Begleite die Weiterentwicklung von Firewall- und Backup-Lösungen und unterstütze die Ablösung der verbleibenden Legacy-Windows-Domäne. Eine spannende IT-Transformation, die du von Anfang an aktiv mitgestalten kannst.

Verantworte das On- und Offboarding unserer Mitarbeitenden: Richte Benutzerkonten, Geräte und Zugriffsrechte ein und stelle sicher, dass vom ersten bis zum letzten Arbeitstag alles reibungslos funktioniert.

Gestalte unsere interne IT-Strategie aktiv mit: Sorge für eine strukturierte und aktuelle Dokumentation, ein gepflegtes Asset-Management sowie eine ordnungsgemäße Verwaltung von Softwarelizenzen.

Qualifikation
