jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 50-60% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Director, Reward, Performance and Analytics
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role overview | Context

As Checkout.com continues to rapidly scale and evolve its international footprint, we are seeking an exceptionally strategic Head of Reward to champion our global total rewards philosophy. Following a significant transformation period within our People team—where we have leveled up our leadership, global equity schemes, operational reporting, and data capabilities—this role is a critical hire designed to transition our reward infrastructure from foundational stability to a high-yield competitive advantage.

Positioned as a key strategic partner to our leadership team, the incoming leader will directly shape a performance-led culture by aligning our total rewards with commercial growth, ensuring we continue to attract and retain world-class talent across the fintech ecosystem.

Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities

We are looking for a seasoned, highly strategic leader with deep domain expertise who can act as an organizational challenger and a trusted partner to senior leadership. Operating with a high degree of emotional intelligence, you will act as a "disruptor" within the people ecosystem, comfortable creating constructive conflict and relentlessly raising the global performance bar alongside the Executive Team. This role demands a leader who steps away from the "ivory tower" to actively collaborate on the ground, driving true organizational adoption of performance and compensation frameworks across all business lines.

  • Global Reward Strategy & Execution: Design, implement, and optimize a comprehensive global reward strategy incorporating base pay, variable compensation, and benefits that are dynamically fit for purpose across every international location.

  • Equity Architecture & Management: Take complete ownership of our global equity strategy, managing the long-term migration away from legacy option models and ledger systems toward a scalable framework that aligns directly with the CHRO and Founder-CEO.

  • Driving a High-Performance Culture: Partner with E-team members to design and aggressively enforce strict performance-driven compensation programs, ensuring people managers globally adopt and execute our unified talent calibration and probation bars.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Insights: Conduct sophisticated market benchmarking and peer analysis within the payments and technology sectors, effectively playing back competitive trends, analytics, and actionable metrics to the CHRO and Founder-CEO.

  • Stakeholder & Founder Alignment: Build deep, high-trust advisory relationships with our Founder-CEO and Executive Team, confidently navigating a fast-moving environment where creative, innovative proposals must balance alongside the strong strategic vision of the primary shareholder.

  • Operational Excellence & Parity: Oversee complex global benefits programs to ensure systemic pay equity, consistency, and structural alignment, providing "flexibility within a framework" to capture critical local nuances.

  • Hands-on Relationship Building: Devote significant energy to working cross-functionally across our regional offices, building deep partnerships with internal teams rather than directing strategy abstractly.

  • Team Leadership: Lead, inspire, and grow a high-performing team of reward and compensation professionals, instilling a culture of continuous development, technical accuracy, and strategic impact.

Role overview | Desired Background, Core Competencies

The ideal candidate for the role will bring:

  • Extensive Domain Leadership: A proven track record of successfully leading global compensation, benefits, and total rewards strategies in fast-paced, high-growth matrixed tech environments.

  • FinTech or High-Growth Scale Experience: Deep experience operating within target sectors including Payments, FinTech, e-commerce, consumer tech, or enterprise software; explicitly holding a strong bias toward private/scale-up environments over rigid public corporate systems.

  • Subject Matter Expertise in Equity: Exceptional technical command over complex equity programs, option structuring, and cap table models—proven ability to strategically navigate evolution in a company's financial valuation structure is paramount.

  • Founder-Led Navigation: Demonstrated success operating inside a high-growth, founder-led organization, showcasing the dexterity to pitch bold, creative ideas while fully respecting and executing the final directional decisions of the CEO.

  • High EQ & Challenger Mentality: An intentional balance of high emotional intelligence with a robust "challenger" mindset; someone who thrives when driving a relentless performance culture, navigating healthy friction, and holding managers accountable.

  • Execution over Design: A track record of not just designing pristine frameworks, but successfully driving enterprise-wide adoption, organizational turnaround, and measurable cultural alignment.

  • Analytical Rigor: Strong capability in leveraging People Analytics and insights to influence strategic business narratives, though happy to compromise slightly on advanced analytics if core reward and equity spikes are extraordinarily strong.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We created Apaleo to change the hospitality industry in a meaningful way. Our API-first property management platform empowers accommodation providers to design a technology stack that creates unique digital guest and staff experiences. At Apaleo, you'll find a diverse, international team united by a passion for learning and building - and we move fast.

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Architect (f/m/d) to join our team in Munich, Germany.

You won't just use AI tools - you'll design and operate the systems that turn marketing into a predictable growth engine: more intelligent, more autonomous, and measurably better at creating demand and pipeline. You'll build on what the team has already started and work shoulder-to-shoulder with channel owners - thinking in workflows, building in pipelines, and measuring everything against one thing: commercial impact, expressed as demand and pipeline.

Your mission

Build the data foundation marketing runs on

  • Audit where marketing data lives today - HubSpot, Google Analytics, LinkedIn, Contentful, etc. - and map how it actually flows (or doesn't) between systems
  • Design clean, structured data connections so every AI workflow downstream has reliable inputs - and so demand and pipeline become measurable end to end
  • Work hand-in-hand with Marketing channel owners to connect what's already there into one coherent commercial data layer that ties activity to pipeline

Build the campaign intelligence layer

  • Architect the campaign lifecycle framework that probably doesn't yet exist: which signals predict demand at each stage, how content maps to pipeline progression, what real-time campaign performance actually requires technically
  • Automate the assembly work - pulling, structuring, and summarising performance data across channels - so the team acts on insight rather than chasing it, and can see what's actually driving pipeline
  • Own and scale the campaign performance analysis pipeline from experiment to production, with demand and pipeline contribution as the headline metric

Build AI workflows that run without you

  • Design prompts, agents, and automated sequences that produce reliable outputs for repeatable marketing tasks without needing constant supervision
  • Build systems the broader marketing team can operate and iterate on independently - so the impact stays even as you move on to the next thing
  • Build toward the long-term vision: a two-way marketing intelligence loop where competitive signals automatically inform messaging, underperforming campaigns trigger content updates, and marketing shifts from reactive to continuously adaptive - compounding into a self-improving demand and pipeline engine

You'd be a great fit if you

  • Think in systems - you map a workflow before you build it, and you can clearly distinguish between steps that should be automated and steps that need a human
  • Have hands-on experience building AI-powered marketing or GTM workflows - content pipelines, enrichment flows, analytics automations, or similar
  • Connect everything to growth - you instinctively tie technical and campaign decisions to demand and pipeline, and you think in funnels, conversion, and pipeline contribution
  • Are comfortable with APIs - you can read documentation, make calls, understand endpoints and data structures, without needing an engineer beside you
  • Can write prompts that work reliably at scale
  • Understand data connectivity: you know how systems like HubSpot, GA, and marketing platforms pass data between each other, and you can design flows that don't break
  • Have a strong commercial instinct - you speak the language of B2B SaaS growth and connect every decision to a business outcome
  • Are comfortable operating in ambiguity - this is a new function and you'll be defining it as much as filling it
  • Are genuinely curious about hospitality technology and the intersection of AI and GTM
  • Write and communicate fluently in English; German is a strong plus

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
jobs.description:
At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation.

  • Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness.

  • Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions.

  • Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. 

  • Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture.

  • Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions.

  • Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments.

  • Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness.

  • Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle.

  • Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities.

  • Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices.

  • Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems.

  • Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python.

  • Experience developing embedded software in C/C++.

  • Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including:

    • Perception

    • State estimation

    • Sensor fusion

    • Motion planning

    • Feedback control

  • Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2.

  • Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors.

  • Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV.

  • Experience implementing real-time control systems.

  • Experience with machine learning for robotic perception.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems.

  • Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics.

  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Fluent English


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Deine Position

At 1KOMMA5°, we connect and manage tens of thousands of distributed energy devices at scale. As a (Senior) Software Engineer - Device Connectivity, you will play a crucial role in integrating OEM devices, such as PV inverters, batteries, charging infrastructure, and heat pumps, into our cutting-edge Heartbeat platform. Your role involves implementing communication protocols, developing software modules on IoT gateway and controller devices, and conducting testing of our energy management system in our lab in Berlin. You will also be providing expert level support for both internal and external stakeholders. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll contribute to the entire product lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the technical integration of inverters, batteries, charging infrastructure, and heat pumps into our Heartbeat energy management system, driving projects end-to-end to deliver solutions on time.
  • Ensure seamless communication and interoperability between different OEM devices.
  • Implement communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, OCPP, MQTT, EEbus.
  • Develop, deploy, and maintain services on our IoT gateway using Go programming.
  • Diagnose network issues across LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls, and protocols, and turn that understanding into resilient edge services.
  • Conduct testing of our energy management system in our lab in Berlin.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure software meets performance and reliability standards.
  • Provide expert-level support to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Foster a culture of experiment-driven innovation within the team


Dein Profil

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Control Engineering or related field.
  • Proven experience in IoT development and integration, with a focus on integrating diverse OEM devices.
  • Hands-on experience in the development of software modules for IoT devices.
  • Experience with Go programming is highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, OCPP, and MQTT.
  • Solid understanding of local area networks (TCP/IP, LAN/WLAN) and experience with device discovery and scanning mechanisms within home networks.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, including continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Prior exposure to energy management systems is desirable.
  • Outstanding, proactive communication skills: you excel at engaging stakeholders and initiating cross-team collaboration
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience quickly finding your way around in cross-functional teams in a fast pace, interdisciplinary working environment
  • An agile and result-oriented mindset and you consider yourself a team player
  • Very good knowledge of spoken and written English, German is a plus
Bonus points for:
  • Experience in network or systems administration (routing, firewalls, DNS, DHCP) in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (ideally Google cloud) and their integration in IoT solutions.
  • Previous experience in providing support to international stakeholders.
  • Certifications related to IoT and energy management

jobs.title: Field Deployment Lead
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Rhoda AI Europe GmbH is the company's first international entity, established to own strategic partner relationships across Europe and drive deployment of RaaS (Robotics as a Service).

We're looking for a Field Deployment lead to oversee Rhoda AI’s intelligent robot real-world customer deployments. We will have the first industrial deployments in the field by Q4-2026. You will be working at the intersection of robotics, AI, hardware, and deployment operations.

The Role

As Rhoda's first Field Deployment Lead in Europe, you will own the end-to-end execution of robot deployments at European partner sites - from site preparation and installation through commissioning, SAT sign-off, and transition to steady-state operations.

You will also build and own the operational framework that keeps deployed robots running: the runbooks, operator training, escalation procedures, spare parts management, and the roster of contract operators and Tier 2 service partners at each site.

This is not a traditional reactive field service role. Your focus is deployment quality and operational continuity - building systems that prevent emergencies, and managing a pre-trained Tier 2 service partner for hardware interventions beyond operator scope. You will work closely with the Application Engineering team on technical setup and with Rhoda HQ Engineering on configuration and maintenance planning.

During the initial production ramp at our first German deployment, you will be on-site covering the day shift alongside contract operators to build firsthand understanding of the system in production - before transitioning to a supervisory and multi-site role as operations mature.

What You'll Do

Deployment Execution

  • Own site preparation, robot installation, system integration, and commissioning at new European partner sites

  • Lead SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) sign-off with partner technical teams; ensure systems meet production-readiness criteria before handover to steady-state ops

  • Coordinate deployment timelines with Rhoda HQ AE and engineering teams; manage site-specific dependencies and risks

  • Document configurations, integration decisions, and site-specific adaptations for each deployment

Operational Framework

  • Design and maintain the operational runbook for each deployed site: error response procedures, escalation paths, consumables management, shift handover standards

  • Train and onboard contract operators at each site; set quality and documentation standards; ensure consistent execution across shifts

  • Manage the Tier 2 local service partner: define scope and SLA, oversee training on Rhoda hardware, manage the callout process

  • Capture field learnings systematically - failure modes, edge cases, near-misses - and feed structured insights to the AE team and HQ Engineering

Maintenance & Reliability

  • Execute scheduled preventative maintenance visits at active sites (monthly/quarterly cadence per site)

  • Coordinate software and firmware updates with HQ Engineering; execute on-site where remote deployment is not possible

  • Manage on-site spare parts inventory at each customer facility

Phase 1 Ramp - Wolfsburg (first 1–2 months)

  • Cover the day shift on-site during initial production ramp to build firsthand operational expertise

  • Transition day shift to the third contract operator once steady-state is established; shift into supervisory and multi-site mode

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial robotics or industrial software deployment, commissioning, or field engineering

  • Hands-on electro-mechanical troubleshooting skills: confident using a multimeter and oscilloscope to diagnose faults, and working with VFDs, PLCs, sensors, actuators, and wiring in an industrial environment

  • Proven track record executing FAT/SAT processes and commissioning robotic or automation systems at industrial customer sites

  • Linux command-line proficiency; comfortable reading Python scripts and shell commands; basic Docker/container operations

  • ROS or ROS2 experience, or equivalent industrial automation background with genuine willingness to learn ROS2 quickly

  • Strong documentation habits: you write runbooks, SOPs, and handover documents that others can follow without asking you

  • Experience training non-technical operators on robotic or automated production equipment

  • Experience managing contractors or external service partners

  • Professional German and English — both required

  • Valid driver's licence

Nice-to-Have

  • Prior experience deploying or commissioning robots at automotive primes or Tier-1 suppliers

  • ISO 10218 / EN ISO 13849 / TS 15066 safety familiarity for industrial robotics

  • Experience with Flexiv Rizon arms, ZED cameras, or comparable industrial robot platforms

  • Background writing and maintaining operational SOPs and field playbooks

  • Experience managing multi-site field operations

Why This Role

  • First field operations hire in Europe — you define how Rhoda deploys and operates in the field

  • Direct line to HQ Remote Operations Center: your field intelligence shapes the product roadmap

  • As Europe scales, you build and lead a growing field operations team — potentially evolving into dedicated deployment and operations functions in 2027

  • Work at the intersection of cutting-edge humanoid robotics and real Tier-1 industrial production environments

jobs.title: Event Management & Brand Experience Expert (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Mittelstandsmandanten erleben Beratungsdienstleister meist in einer fast austauschbaren Eventsprache — schmucklose Konferenzhotels, Standard-Catering, Programm-Logik, die in jedem Raum gleich aussieht. Die Begegnung mit Beratungsfirmen ist selten ein Erlebnis. Genau dort liegt der Hebel für ein anderes Modell — über alle Anlass-Größen hinweg, vom Webinar bis zur Mittelstandskonferenz.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir bauen gerade die Event-Infrastruktur für dieses Beziehungsnetzwerk: Roundtables, Wein- und Ski-Retreats, Salon-Formate, individualisierte Mandanten-Dinner, perspektivisch eine eigene Mittelstandskonferenz in Aalen mit mehren hundert Teilnehmern, plus eine laufende Webinar-Cadence und sorgfältig kuratierte Messeauftritte. Auch unsere internen Mitarbeiterevents — Town Halls, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Off-sites — sollen Vogel-Erlebnisse sein, nicht Standard-Firmenfeste. Jeder Anlass, ob extern oder intern, ist geprägt von warmer Tischkultur, kuratierter Gästedichte, materiellem Detail und einem Sense of Place, der in der Beratungslandschaft selten ist.

Du bist Hospitality-Profi mit echter Premium-DNA — drei bis fünf Jahre in einer Premium-Hotelmarke wie Aman, Rosewood oder Soho House, in einem gehobenen Restaurant oder bei einer Premium-Event-Brand mit Family-Office- oder Premium-Konferenz-Anspruch. Du hast neben Flagship-Anlässen auch die operative Cadence gelernt — Veranstaltungen in hoher Frequenz mit gleichem Detail-Standard. Du wechselst aus dem reinen Operations-Modus eines Top-Hotels in eine Rolle, in der du Format-Mit-Architektin wirst, nicht Umsetzungs-Vehikel. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen — etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis — plus eine Hospitality-Architektur im Aufbau, die du von Anfang an mitbaust.

Du verantwortest die gesamte eventgetriebene Hospitality- und Brand-Experience der Vogel-Marke — Flagship-Anlässe für Mandanten; die laufende Webinar-Cadence; die internen Mitarbeiterevents; sowie ausgewählte Messeauftritte. Du arbeitest in München als Teil des Brand & Content Teams, berichtest an den Brand & Content Lead und arbeitest im Aufbau-Charakter dieser Erstrolle eng direkt mit Moritz Vogel an ausgewählten Veranstaltungen und Formaten. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in eine Senior-Rolle wie Lead Event & Brand Experience mit eigener Hospitality-Architektur über mehrere Standorte.

Deine Verantwortung

Flagship-Anlässe und individualisierte Formate

  • Entwirf und trage die Vogel-Flagship-Format-Library — Salon, kuratierte Dinner, Roundtable, Wein- und Ski-Retreat, Mandanten-Dinner-Standardisierung — vom Konzept bis zum letzten Detail. Fünfzehn bis zwanzig Flagship-Anlässe pro Jahr in München, Aalen und weiteren Standorten.

  • Architektiere die Aalen-Mittelstandskonferenz — Bühne, Programm, Catering, Eingangserlebnis, Brand-DNA-Konsistenz. Vorlauf ab Q4 2026, erste Auflage 2027.

  • Trage individualisierte Eins-zu-eins- und Small-Group-Formate — Premium-Mandanten-Dinner mit Branchen-Cut, persönliche Multiplier-Termine, kuratierte Salons in kleinem Kreis. Mass-Customized statt skaliert.

Operative Cadence — Webinare, Mitarbeiterevents, Messen

  • Trage die kontinuierliche Webinar-Cadence von zwei bis drei Anlässen pro Woche. Die Berater halten inhaltlich, du koordinierst den kompletten Ablauf und sicherst, dass jedes Webinar im ästhetischen Anspruch unserem Standard genügt — Bewerbung in Abstimmung mit dem Editorial & Community Associate, Tech-Setup, Run-of-Show, Nachgang (Recording-Bearbeitung, Follow-Up-Mails, Social-Snippets, Lead-Verfolgung in Attio).

  • Verantworte den Rahmen unserer internen Mitarbeiterevents — Town Halls, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Off-sites, Standort-Treffen, Onboarding-Cohorts. Innen-Hospitality auf demselben Detail-Standard wie außen, weil das Erlebnis dort genauso prägend ist wie für Mandanten.

  • Steuere die Vogel-Präsenz auf ausgewählten Mittelstands- und Branchenmessen — Stand-Konzeption gegen das Stylebook, Logistik, Vor-Ort-Präsenz. Vogel-Ästhetik statt Standard-Konferenz-Booth.

Brand-Quality-Gate und Operations-Standards

  • Halte jede Veranstaltung gegen die Vogel-Brand-DNA als laufender Filter — warme Tischkultur und archaische Reduktion als Polarität, Material-Vokabular (Cortenstahl, Travertin, geöltes Eichenholz, Leinen, Petrolgrün). Bei Decks für Webinare und Live-Events: enge Abstimmung mit dem Brand & Content Lead.

  • Pflege die Gästeliste in Kuratur-Modus — Multiplier, Mandanten, Senior-Mitarbeiter — gemeinsam mit Moritz Vogel, Business Development und dem Brand & Content Lead.

  • Dokumentiere wiederverwendbare Vogel-Hospitality-Standards (Eingangsritual, Service-Choreografie, Webinar-Run-of-Show, Mitarbeiterevent-Playbook, Messestand-Spec) als Brand-Asset. Iteriere täglich mit dem Brand & Content Lead, regelmäßig mit Moritz an der Format-Roadmap.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast die ersten Flagship-Roundtables und -Retreats eigenständig getragen und parallel die Webinar-Cadence übernommen — alle Anlässe vor- und nachbereitet.

  • Du hast den Aalen-Konferenz-Vorlaufplan in eigener Skizze vorgelegt (Location-Shortlist, Format-Architektur, Multiplier-Mapping).

  • Du hast eine eigene Format-Library aufgebaut — Flagship, Webinar-Run-of-Show, Mitarbeiterevent-Playbook.

Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du trägst fünfzehn bis zwanzig Flagship-Anlässe plus die laufende Webinar-Cadence eigenständig.

  • Du hast die Aalen-Konferenz 2027 architektonisch aufgesetzt — Bühne, Programm, Catering, Eingangserlebnis, Brand-DNA-Konsistenz.

  • Du hast die internen Mitarbeiterevents — Town Hall, Sommerfest, Off-sites — auf Vogel-Hospitality-Standard gehoben.

  • Du hast Vogel-Messeauftritte mit eigenem Stand-Konzept umgesetzt.

  • Du hast eine eigene Multiplier-Sourcing-Mechanik für Einladungen entwickelt — kuratiert, in der Vogel-Tischkultur, ohne Massenversand.

Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Die Aalen-Konferenz ist als sichtbarer Erfolg gelaufen, mit nachweisbarer Reputation in der mittelständischen Beratungs- und Mandanten-Welt.

  • Du bist Mit-Architektin der Hospitality- und Brand-Experience-Architektur über mehrere Standorte (München, Aalen, perspektivisch weitere).

  • Du bist Kandidatin für die nächste Lead-Stufe (Lead Event & Brand Experience).

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Der nächste Schritt ist eine Senior-Rolle wie Lead Event & Brand Experience (IC-Karriere) — das setzt eine eigenständig getragene Hospitality-Architektur und sichtbare Vogel-Format-Reputation voraus, nicht zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Über weitere Verantwortung öffnet sich der Pfad entlang unseres Karriere-Frameworks.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du hast drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Premium-Hospitality gesammelt — in einer Premium-Hotelmarke (Aman, Rosewood, Soho House oder vergleichbar), einem gehobenen Restaurant mit Service-Anspruch oder bei einer Premium-Event-Brand mit Family-Office- oder Premium-Konferenz-Profil (Stripe Sessions, Hill House Vintage oder vergleichbar).

  • Du hast nicht nur Flagship-Anlässe verantwortet, sondern auch operative Cadence in hoher Frequenz — Webinare, Hosted Online-Sessions, Premium-Veranstaltungsreihen, die im gleichen Detail-Standard wiederkehrend funktionieren.

  • Du hast Detail-Ownership — Eingangsritual, Beleuchtungs-Sensibilität, Tischwein-Auswahl, Service-Choreografie. Diese Detail-Sprache ist deine Reference-Class, nicht „Eventmanagement" im generischen Sinn.

  • Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber Format-Architektur und Premium-Detail-Sensibilität mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Innenarchitekten mit Eventbau-Praxis, Producer aus Editorial-Magazinen mit Live-Format-Erfahrung, Die ausgeschriebene Range kalibriert auf das Primärprofil. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast Detail-Geschmack — du erkennst im Catering-Briefing, im Lichtkonzept oder in der Bestuhlungs-Logik intuitiv, was trägt und was kippt.

  • Du sprichst Premium-Hospitality-Vokabular — du verstehst, warum Aman, Soho House und Drei-Sterne-Restaurants anders funktionieren als Standard-Konferenzhotellerie.

  • Du beherrschst die operative Cadence — Webinar-Tooling (Zoom, Hopin, Teams Live oder vergleichbar), Run-of-Show-Logik, Tech-Setup, Multi-Tracking. Operative Engpässe löst du selbst, statt sie zu eskalieren.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche (Location-Sourcing, Multiplier-Listen), Drafting (Einladungs-Texte, Run-of-Show-Schablonen) und Format-Iteration.

  • Du iterierst eigenständig und schnell — Format-Skizzen in Stunden, nicht Tagen oder Wochen. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern bringst die Idee in den ersten Termin mit.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

  • Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Mandanten, Senior-Berater und die Geschäftsführung wissen Dinge über die Mittelstands-Welt, die in keinem Hospitality-Playbook stehen.

  • Du verträgst direkte Zuarbeit für die Geschäftsführung — das heißt schnelle Iteration, hohe Eigenständigkeit und Detail-Verantwortung, die andere für Selbstverständlichkeit halten.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Kein klassischer Event-Manager-Job mit ausgelagerter Logistik. Du machst Format-Architektur und Operations gleichzeitig — vom Konzept bis zur Eingangs-Choreografie, vom Webinar-Tech-Setup bis zum Recording-Cut.

  • Kein reines Webinar-Marketing. Du machst nicht nur Tooling-Setup für Online-Sessions — du verantwortest die gesamte Brand-Experience über alle Anlass-Größen.

  • Kein Hochglanz-Agentur-Workflow. Wir iterieren in kurzen Zyklen, produzieren in kleinen Teams und schrauben am Detail selbst.

  • Kein klassischer Mittelstands-Beratungs-Eventmanager-Job mit Standard-Konferenzhotellerie. Wer Format-Architektur als Add-on zum Logistik-Setup sieht, sitzt hier am falschen Schreibtisch.

  • Kein Karriere-Aufstieg durch Personalspanne. Du wächst durch fachliche Tiefe in Hospitality und Mit-Architektur der Vogel-Marke, nicht durch immer mehr Direct Reports — Mastery-Karriere heißt sichtbar werden in der Methodik, nicht in der Teamgröße.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen.

3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus?

Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.

Wir suchen Dich ab sofor t an einem unserer deutschen Standorte in München, Nürnberg, Frankfurt am Main, Essen, Leipzig oder Berlin!

Deine Aufgaben

Data und AI sind Dein zu Hause? Deine neue Herausforderung gestaltet sich wie folgt:

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Data Architects, Business Analysts und Infrastrukturteams zur Optimierung und Wartung komplexer ETL-Prozesse, um große Datenmengen effizient aus unterschiedlichen Quellsystemen zu verarbeiten
  • Sicherstellung von Datenqualität, -integration und -modellierung im Rahmen moderner Data-Engineering-Architekturen wie SQL, relationale Datenbanken (PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle)
  • Programmierungen mit Python, Scala oder Java, Git
  • Durchführung von Performance-Tuning und Fehleranalysen für komplexe Graphen und Prozesse zur Stabilisierung von Produktionsabläufen
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung von Projekten im Umfeld von Data Governance, Data Catalogs und regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. DORA)

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Mobile focus
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Staff Product Designer, Mobile to own the design direction across our apps and lead the craft of every designer who works on them. This is a senior individual contributor role with manager-level scope: you carry the design direction and UX/UI patterns across three teams (Apps Meta, Apps Retention, and Mobile Design Systems) while still designing and shipping yourself. You set the quality bar for all Apps design output, you hold it across teams, and you keep engineering pointed at the right work. You are the technical lead for apps design, accountable for the quality and velocity of what the apps designers produce, without managing them directly.

This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it.

  • Set the quality standard for apps design and hold it as a discipline, not a project. Make the bar visible where teams miss it, and close gaps across teams that you did not personally create. You are accountable for the quality and velocity of all apps design output.

  • Run planning and discovery for all three teams. Break multi-team, loosely defined problems into clear design direction the designers can run with.

  • Partner with the Director of Product for Apps and the apps PMs on core initiatives, influencing roadmap and prioritization through design rationale.

  • Lead native craft across iOS and Android. Set the approach for resizability, foldables, new screen sizes, and solve how KAYAK responds to platform chrome shifts like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive.

  • Lead the design approach for mobile AI features: how we integrate AI into the apps, the UI, and the navigation around it, so it lands as a native part of the experience.

  • Drive the brand differentiation work for our portfolio of hero brands apps like momondo to ensure local market dominance.

  • Raise the ceiling for the other apps designers through critique, shared standards, and patterns they build on. Designers should get better by working alongside you and using what you establish, not only through direct mentorship.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped, high-impact mobile work at consumer scale.

  • Deep native expertise across iOS and Android. Mastery of Apple HIG and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to converge and when to honor platform difference. Hands-on experience with resizability, foldables, and iPad, and a point of view on platform chrome directions like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive.

  • A track record of raising design quality across a discipline beyond your own projects, through standards you set, critiques you ran, or systems others still use.

  • Experience driving design direction across multiple teams or product areas, with the ability to influence without authority.

  • Experience building or evolving mobile design systems and scalable patterns.

  • Strong with Figma, and fluent with AI-assisted design and prototyping tooling (for example Claude Code or Cursor).

  • Comfort using data and research to set direction and measure outcomes.

Please apply if you have:

  • Experience managing or leading designers. This is an IC role, so it counts as a strong plus rather than a requirement.

  • Driven design vision across teams in a way you can tie to outcomes, not just deliverables.

  • Formal education in design (BA, BFA, MFA) or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

jobs.description:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

We are looking for a Mid-Level Security Engineer to own the hands-on engineering and operational work within our security program. You will be embedded in the Cloud Engineering team, report into the Security Officer, and work closely together to identify risks, set priorities, and drive security issues through remediation. You will act as a security enabler across all Product & Engineering.

What you will own

  • Run our public bug bounty program: triage reports, reproduce and validate findings, communicate clearly with security researchers, and drive remediation through to closure.

  • Investigate reported vulnerabilities at the code level, including our Rust core, Go and Python tooling.

  • Enable engineers to build secure systems: provide tooling, paved-road defaults, documentation, and practical guidance so security is the easy path, not a checkpoint.

  • Partner with engineering teams to design, review, and verify fixes, and set clear security requirements on changes where the risk warrants it.

  • Harden and maintain our GitHub organization’s security posture, including secret scanning, push protection, branch protection and rulesets, dependency alerts, and code scanning, in partnership with the engineering teams that use these repositories daily.

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and related infrastructure.

  • Track and report security metrics (vulnerability remediation SLAs, MTTR, patch latency, critical findings) and keep reporting current for the Security Officer.

jobs.title: Growth Internship (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Ein Beratungsunternehmen wächst an zwei Fronten gleichzeitig: neue Mandanten und neue Mitarbeiter. In den meisten Unternehmen sind das zwei getrennte Abteilungen, die nichts voneinander wissen. Bei uns ist es dieselbe Arbeit — Menschen finden, ansprechen, eine Beziehung halten.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Darauf bauen wir die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand: Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe, konsolidieren einen fragmentierten Markt und integrieren jede neue Einheit in ein gemeinsames Setup. Wir bauen gerade die Wachstums-Funktion auf, die dieses Unternehmen in den nächsten Jahren trägt. Du arbeitest in diesen drei bis sechs Monaten unmittelbar daran mit.

Du studierst noch und willst herausfinden, ob dir die Arbeit mit Menschen liegt, bevor du dich festlegst. Du suchst kein Praktikum, in dem du Listen pflegst, während andere die Gespräche führen. Genau deshalb ist diese Rolle breit angelegt: Du sitzt in Gesprächen mit Unternehmern und in Gesprächen mit Kandidaten und siehst, dass beides dieselbe Fähigkeit verlangt.

Deine Verantwortung

Recherche und Ansprache

  • Recherchiere mittelständische Unternehmen, für die unsere Beratung passt, und bereite die Ansprache vor — mit einem konkreten Grund je Unternehmen, nicht mit einer Serienvorlage.

  • Recherchiere Kandidatenprofile für unsere offenen Stellen und bereite die Erstansprache vor.

  • Bereite Gespräche inhaltlich vor, sodass die Person, die das Gespräch führt, nichts mehr nachschlagen muss.

Gespräche und Talent Operations

  • Begleite Erstgespräche mit potenziellen Mandanten und mit Kandidaten und übernimm über die Zeit eigene Teile davon.

  • Verantworte die Nachbereitung: Gesprächsnotizen, nächste Schritte, Termine. Was nach dem Gespräch nicht festgehalten wird, ist nicht passiert.

  • Unterstütze die Recruiting-Operations — Terminkoordination, Ashby-Pflege, Rückmeldungen an Kandidaten. Wie wir mit Absagen umgehen, prägt unseren Ruf stärker als jede Anzeige.

Veranstaltungen und Auswertung

  • Arbeite bei unseren Formaten mit — Vorbereitung, Ablauf vor Ort, Nachverfolgung der Kontakte.

  • Werte aus, was funktioniert: Welche Ansprache bekommt Antworten, welche Quelle bringt gute Kandidaten, welches Format trägt.

  • Halte die Pipeline sauber und mach sichtbar, wo Kontakte liegen bleiben.

Deine Perspektiven

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Der Regelweg führt in den Berufseinstieg Growth und von dort auf die Manager-Stufe in Business Development & Client Growth oder in Talent Growth. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen beide offen. Was du bekommst, entsteht am Beitrag — Berufsjahre allein bewegen bei uns nichts.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du studierst — Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Kommunikation, Psychologie, Geistes- oder Sozialwissenschaften oder etwas anderes, das du gut machst.

  • Du hast bereits mit Menschen gearbeitet, die dir nichts schulden: Nebenjob im Verkauf, Veranstaltungsorganisation, Vereinsarbeit, eine eigene Initiative.

  • Du bist in irgendeinem Feld über den Durchschnitt hinausgegangen und kannst erklären, wie.

  • Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber Beziehungs-Substanz mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Studierende aus dem Leistungssport mit eigener Sponsoring- oder Vereinsverantwortung; Menschen mit Erfahrung in Gastronomie oder Hotellerie; Studierende, die eine Hochschulinitiative aufgebaut und Menschen dafür gewonnen haben. Die ausgewiesene Range bezieht sich auf das Primärprofil. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis — beim Übergang in eine Festanstellung gilt dieselbe Logik wie für alle: Vergütung folgt dem Beitrag. Nachzulesen in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du schreibst Nachrichten, auf die Menschen antworten — konkret, kurz, mit einem erkennbaren Grund für den Kontakt.

  • Du hörst zu und stellst die zweite Frage.

  • Du arbeitest mit AI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug — Recherche zu Unternehmen und Kandidaten, Vorbereitung, Drafting.

  • Du arbeitest sauber im System und lässt keine Kontakte liegen.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du erträgst Absagen und lernst aus jeder einzelnen etwas Konkretes.

  • Du bringst Respekt vor Unternehmertum mit — auf der anderen Seite sitzt jemand mit persönlichem Risiko.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Kein Praktikum als Listenpfleger. Du sitzt in den Gesprächen, statt sie nur vorzubereiten.

  • Kein Skript-Modus mit Anruf-Kennzahlen. Im Mittelstand entsteht Vertrauen über Zeit, nicht über Frequenz.

  • Keine reine Recruiting-Funktion. Du arbeitest an beiden Wachstums-Fronten — Mandanten und Menschen.

  • Kein „irgendwann darfst du mal eigenständig arbeiten“. Bei uns gilt ab Tag eins: du machst, du trägst, du wirst korrigiert, wenn es nötig ist — aber du wartest nicht.

FAQ

jobs.title: Associate, Investments
jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our investment organization with leaders who can combine rigorous underwriting with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring an Associate, Investments to join our investment team.

Reporting to the Principal leading the investments team, you will support the underwriting, execution and portfolio management of investments across Radiant's AI infrastructure platform. Working closely with senior members of the investment and executive leadership, you will help evaluate new opportunities, develop financial models, coordinate due diligence and support transaction execution.

This is an exceptional opportunity to work at the intersection of power, compute, capital and software, gaining exposure to complex infrastructure investments while helping deploy significant capital into assets that will underpin the next era of the AI economy.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain financial models for GPU clusters, AI factories and strategic infrastructure investments.

  • Perform financial analysis including valuation, returns modelling, scenario analysis and risk assessment.

  • Support commercial evaluations of customer contracts, GPU procurement strategies, power pricing and operating assumptions.

  • Assist in screening and evaluating new investment opportunities.

  • Coordinate and support due diligence across commercial, technical, financial and legal workstreams.

  • Support transaction execution, including acquisitions, joint ventures, development partnerships and strategic investments.

  • Work alongside the capital markets and finance teams to evaluate financing alternatives and capital structures.

  • Prepare investment committee materials, management presentations and transaction analyses.

  • Monitor portfolio performance against underwriting assumptions and identify value creation opportunities.

  • Support strategic business planning and investment portfolio analysis.

  • Develop market intelligence across AI infrastructure, GPU supply chains, power markets, hyperscaler demand and capital markets.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in infrastructure investing, private equity, investment banking, project finance, digital infrastructure or a related field.

  • Strong financial modelling, valuation and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience supporting investment transactions or complex financial analyses.

  • Excellent quantitative skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong commercial judgement and problem-solving ability.

  • Highly motivated, intellectually curious and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality work under tight timelines.

  • High levels of ownership, accountability and professionalism.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

  • Exposure to project finance, infrastructure debt or structured financing.

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure or hyperscaler ecosystems.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, lenders or infrastructure funds.

What Success Looks Like

  • Become a trusted member of Radiant's investment team.

  • Build high-quality underwriting models that support investment decisions.

  • Contribute to the successful execution of AI infrastructure investments.

  • Develop strong relationships across internal teams and external counterparties.

  • Grow into increasing levels of responsibility across underwriting, transaction execution and portfolio management.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry in a platform with strong operational capabilities and access to capital.

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

  • Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our capital markets capabilities with leaders who can combine rigorous underwriting with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As Radiant scales its portfolio of GPU clusters, AI factories, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Treasury Manager to support the Group's treasury function, partnering with the Group Finance Director and Head of Capital Markets to build a best in class treasury operation.

You will play a central role in managing Radiant's cash and liquidity position, supporting bank relationships and financing activities, and helping build out treasury processes and controls as the business scales. You will work closely with finance, capital markets, accounting, and the wider business to ensure the Group has the visibility and controls it needs over its cash, funding, and financial risk exposures.

This is an opportunity to help build treasury capabilities from the ground up within a fast-growing AI infrastructure platform, working alongside senior finance leadership on high-impact, high-visibility initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day cash management activities, including bank account administration, payments oversight, and intercompany funding.

  • Prepare and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts across the Group, monitoring actual versus forecast performance.

  • Support management of banking relationships, including account opening/closing, KYC processes, and day-to-day bank queries.

  • Assist with the administration of financing arrangements, including drawdowns, covenant monitoring, and compliance reporting.

  • Support treasury-related aspects of financing transactions, including due diligence, documentation review, and liaison with lenders and advisors.

  • Monitor and help manage financial risk exposures (FX, interest rate, and counterparty risk), including implementing hedging strategies where appropriate.

  • Maintain and develop treasury policies, procedures, and controls, ensuring compliance with internal governance requirements.

  • Prepare treasury reporting and analysis for senior management, including liquidity, debt, and risk dashboards.

  • Partner with the wider finance team on cash forecasting, working capital initiatives, and ad hoc treasury projects as the function scales.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–8 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, banking, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of cash and liquidity management, banking operations, and financial risk management.

  • Experience with financing documentation, covenant monitoring, or debt administration is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with treasury management systems (TMS) or ERP systems including implementation is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance and the wider business.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability when handling sensitive financial information.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the function scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Nice to Have

  • Professional qualification (or progress towards one), such as ACT (Association of Corporate Treasurers), ACA, ACCA, or CFA.

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Exposure to project or acquisition finance, syndicated debt, or capital markets transactions.

  • Experience with FX and interest rate hedging instruments.

  • Familiarity with treasury management systems (e.g., Kyriba, GTreasury, or similar).

What Success Looks Like

  • Robust, reliable cash flow forecasting and reporting across the Group.

  • Strong, well-managed banking relationships and efficient payment processes.

  • Clear visibility and proactive management of the Group's financial risk exposures.

  • Well-documented and controlled treasury policies that scale with the business.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the wider team.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.
